title: LAGO
text: LAGO R package two user-facing functions lago_optimization() visualize_cost(). lago_optimization() carries LAGO optimizations, visualize_cost() helps choose cost functions intervention components. lago_optimization() supports three goal modes: outcome goal alone, power goal alone, together. least one outcome_goal power_goal must provided. provided, effective outcome goal used optimization higher outcome goal outcome level implied power goal (“whichever higher” rule). power goal supported binary outcomes requires group column plus num_centers_in_next_stage patients_per_center_in_next_stage; combined outcome_goal_intention = "minimize". participants clustered within centers, pass intra-cluster correlation icc (single value, c(control, treatment)) identify clustering column power_goal_cluster_id. power calculation inflates variance test statistic design effect, meeting power goal requires stronger intervention. Without icc, power calculation treats participants independent. functions take many arguments. understand input arguments, read help files running following code R (step HIGHLY recommended, please moving examples):
code: help(lago_optimization) help(visualize_cost)

text: consider hypothetical example based built-R dataset ‘mtcars’. scenario contrived; purpose demonstrate mechanics running LAGO optimization real dataset. ‘mtcars’ data extracted 1974 Motor Trend US magazine, comprises fuel consumption 10 aspects automobile design performance 32 automobiles (1973–74 models). , focus following variables: ‘mpg’ - miles per gallon, ‘gear’ - number forward gears, ‘qsec’ - quarter mile time seconds. Suppose ‘mpg’ outcome interest, ‘gear’ ‘qsec’ two intervention components. interested estimating recommended intervention package (values ‘gear’ ‘qsec’) expected achieve outcome goal 40 miles per gallon. expect estimated outcome without intervention going less 40, implementing two intervention components can increase value outcome (corresponds setting outcome_goal_intention = "maximize"). also interested obtaining 95% confidence set, list intervention package compositions can expected include optimal intervention 95% trials. confidence set, interested integer values intervention components, corresponds setting confidence_set_grid_step_size = c(1, 1). Since ‘mpg’ continuous variable, can fit linear regression outcome ‘mpg’ predictors ‘gear’ ‘qsec’. , suppose know lower upper bounds ‘gear’ ‘qsec’ : 0 <= ‘gear’ <= 10 0 <= ‘qsec’ <= 350, total monetary cost implementing ‘gear’ (x1x_1) ‘qsec’ (x2x_2) C(x1)=4x1C(x_1) = 4x_1, C(x2)=4+6x2C(x_2) = 4 + 6x_2, respectively. running LAGO optimizations: Typical output: output , see ‘gear’ ‘qsec’ positive effects ‘mpg’, recommended intervention ‘gear’ = 10 ‘qsec’ = 11.96. adjust cost functions C(x1)=4x1C(x_1) = 4x_1 C(x2)=4+6x2C(x_2) = 4 + 6x_2, visualize_cost() lets visualize select cost functions: visualize_cost() creates Shiny app allows user adjust coefficients cost functions intervention component visualize resulting total cost function unit cost function. initial coefficients calculated based unit costs, default cost function type (linear cubic), lower upper bounds. user can adjust coefficients using sliders reset initial values. app also displays current coefficient vector component. user can copy final coefficient list (bottom app) use lago_optimization(). BetterBirth Study assessed use World Health Organization’s () Safe Childbirth Checklist, 31-item checklist best labor delivery practices believed feasible resource-limited settings, reduce maternal neonatal mortality. intervention adapted tested three-phase process. setting, neonatal mortality 32 per 1,000 live births maternal mortality 258 per 100,000 births (Semrau et al. 2017). Suppose want identify optimal intervention package cost intervention minimized probability desired binary outcome, oxytocin administered (‘pp3_oxytocin_mother’), given threshold (85%). two intervention components ‘coaching_updt’ (x1x_1), number coaching updates, ‘launch_duration’ (x2x_2), launch duration days. title: LAGO
text: README document every input argument, every component outcome model, optimization algorithm behind recommended interventions. can also fit ‘center-level’ data, change optimization method, add interaction terms covariates, test overall intervention effect. Please refer R help files examples manual tests folder details. can start simpler ones, like identity link built-dataset, logistic link BetterBirth dataset moving files. want learn include power goal, please start file test_binary_power_goal, BetterBirth data used. must add group column data calling lago_optimization(). unconditional power approach default; set power_goal_approach = "conditional" use conditional approach instead. account within-center clustering power calculation, see test_icc_power, shows icc argument shifts recommended intervention. complete set runnable .Rmd examples, grouped topic: Recommended interventions: - test_rec_int_for_cts_identity — continuous outcome identity link, built-mtcars dataset. - test_rec_int_for_BB_data — binary outcome logistic link, BetterBirth dataset. - test_rec_int_for_BB_data_cts — BetterBirth proportions modeled continuous outcome. Goal modes power: - test_goal_modes — three goal modes: outcome goal alone, power goal alone, together. - test_binary_power_goal — power goal binary outcome, unconditional conditional approaches. - test_icc_power — within-center clustering power calculation, via icc. Cost functions: - test_default_cost_function — default cost function derived unit costs bounds. - test_higher_order_costs — higher-order (example, cubic) cost functions. - test_visualize_cost — visualize_cost() Shiny app choosing cost-function coefficients. Confidence set optimization algorithm: - test_confidence_set — 95% confidence set, read size cost range. - test_shrinking_method — shrinking method, used outcome goal reachable. - test_shrinking_with_power_goal — shrinking method power goal. Outcome model testing: - test_fit_diagnostics — fit diagnostics warn questionable outcome model (glm warnings, near-singular estimates, non-significant components) optimization continues. - test_overall_intervention — overall intervention-effect test, reported group column supplied.

title: Non-fatal diagnostics for the fitted outcome model — diagnose_model_fit
text: Checks fitted glm signs fit unreliable issues warnings (never errors) LAGO optimization can continue. Covers three Tier-1 checks:   1. glm fit warnings captured fitting (separation signal).   2. separation / near-non-identifiability, detected via extremely large      coefficient standard errors relative estimates.   3. intervention-component effects statistically significant,      make corresponding part recommendation unreliable.

title: get_recommended_interventions — get_recommended_interventions
text: data data frame. dataset contains intervention components outcome variable. intervention_components_coeff numeric vector. coefficient estimates intervention components including intercept term. example: c(0.1, 0.3, 0.15). include_interaction_terms boolean. Specifies whether interaction terms intervention components. main_components character vector. Specifies main intervention components presence interaction terms. intervention_components character vector. names columns dataset represent intervention components. all_center_lvl_effects numeric vector. coefficient estimates facilities, includes fixed center effects fixed time effects. center_weights_for_outcome_goal numeric vector. Specifies weights facilities. weights sum 1. cost_list_of_vectors list numeric vectors. Specifies cost functions intervention component. numeric vector list contains coefficients cost function one intervention component. example: list(c(1, 2, 3, 4), c(4, 6), c(5, 4, 3)) represents: - First component: cost = 1 + 2x_1 + 3x_1^2 + 4x_1^3 - Second component: cost = 4 + 6x_2 - Third component: cost = 5 + 4x_3 + 3x_3^2 list(c(0, 2), c(0, 6), c(0, 4)) represents: - First component: cost = 2x_1 - Second component: cost = 6x_2 - Third component: cost = 4x_3 intervention_lower_bounds numeric vector. Specifies lower bounds intervention components. example: two-component intervention package, lower bounds c(0,0). intervention_upper_bounds numeric vector. Specifies upper bounds intervention components. example: two-component intervention package, upper bounds c(10,20). outcome_goal numeric value. Specifies outcome goal, desired probability mean value. optimization_method character string. Specifies method used LAGO optimization. Must either "numerical" "grid_search". Default value without user specification: "numerical". - Use "grid_search" want exhaustively test every possible intervention package compositions LAGO optimization. - Use "numerical" want use gradient-based technique LAGO optimization. optimization_grid_search_step_size numeric vector. Specifies step size grid search algorithm used LAGO optimization. Default value without user specification: 1/20 range intervention component. center_cha_coeff_vec numeric vector. coefficients estimates center characteristics. example: c(-0.4). center_characteristics_optimization_values numeric vector. fixed values center characteristics recommended intervention computed, recommendation specific center characteristic values. Must length order center_characteristics. example: c(1.75) link character string. Specifies link function used fitting outcome model. lower_outcome_goal boolean value. Specifies whether outcome goal intended lower higher average outcome. prev_recommended_interventions numeric vector. Specifies recommended interventions previous stage. shrinkage_threshold numeric value. Specifies threshold shrinking recommended intervention towards recommended intervention previous stage. power_goal numeric value. Specifies power goal, desired power value 0 1. power_goal_approach character string. Specifies approach used achieve power goal. Must either "unconditional" "conditional". num_centers_in_next_stage numeric value. Specifies number centers next stage. patients_per_center_in_next_stage numeric value. Specifies number patients per center next stage. outcome_name character string. Specifies name outcome variable dataset. icc numeric value [0, 1), length-2 numeric vector c(control, treatment). title: lago_optimization — lago_optimization
text: data data.frame. input dataset containing variables interest. input_data_structure character string. data structure input data. Must either "individual_level" "center_level". Default value without user specification: "individual_level". outcome_name character string. name column dataset represents outcome interest. outcome_type character string. Specifies type outcome. Must either "continuous" continuous outcomes "binary" binary outcomes. intervention_components character vector. names columns dataset represent intervention components. example: c("component1", "component2"). intervention_lower_bounds numeric vector. Specifies lower bounds intervention components. example: two-component intervention package, lower bounds c(0,0). intervention_upper_bounds numeric vector. Specifies upper bounds intervention components. example: two-component intervention package, upper bounds c(10,20). outcome_goal numeric value. Specifies outcome goal, desired probability mean value. Default value without user specification: NULL. least one outcome_goal power_goal must provided. power goal provided, optimization target outcome level needed achieve power goal. provided, effective outcome goal higher two (see power_goal). outcome_goal_intention character string. Specifies direction interventions expected move outcome, relative outcome without intervention. Must either "maximize" "minimize". Set "maximize" larger outcome desired interventions meant increase outcome outcome goal (example, increasing probability treatment administered). Set "minimize" smaller outcome desired interventions meant decrease outcome outcome goal (example, reducing mortality rate). argument controls optimization direction; outcome goal always given target outcome value, regardless intention. Default value without user specification: "maximize". Note: "minimize" combined power goal, achieving power goal requires increasing outcome. power_goal numeric value. Specifies power goal, desired power value (0 1). supported binary outcomes, requires 'group' column (values "treatment"/"control") along num_centers_in_next_stage patients_per_center_in_next_stage. least one outcome_goal power_goal must provided. power goal converted outcome level needed achieve power; effective outcome goal used optimization max(power-implied outcome, outcome_goal). power goal provided, power-implied outcome used directly. Default value without user specification: NULL. power_goal_approach character string. Specifies approach achieve power goal. Must either "unconditional" "conditional". Default value without user specification: "unconditional". num_centers_in_next_stage numeric value. Specifies number total centers (treatment + control) next stage trial. Default value without user specification: NULL. patients_per_center_in_next_stage numeric value. Specifies number patients per center next stage trial. Default value without user specification: NULL. icc numeric value [0, 1), length-2 numeric vector c(control, treatment). Specifies intra-cluster correlation used inflate variance power-calculation test statistic design effect, power goal accounts within-center clustering. used power_goal provided (ignored otherwise). NULL, power calculation assumes independent observations (original behavior); icc = 0 gives identical result. larger icc raises outcome level needed meet power goal, recommends stronger intervention. non-zero icc requires power_goal_cluster_id. Default value without user specification: NULL. power_goal_cluster_id character string. name column data identifying stage-1 centers (clusters), used compute stage-1 design effect power calculation. Required icc non-zero. stage-1 cluster size variance-appropriate (size-biased) mean sum(m_i^2) / sum(m_i) arm's centers, arm must least two centers. Default value without user specification: NULL. unit_costs numeric vector. Specifies unit costs intervention component. Default value without user specification: NULL. default_cost_fxn_type character string. Specifies shape default cost function. Must either "linear" "cubic". Default value without user specification: "cubic". cost_list_of_vectors list numeric vectors. Specifies cost functions intervention component. numeric vector list contains coefficients cost function one intervention component. example: list(c(1, 2, 3, 4), c(4, 6), c(5, 4, 3)) represents: - First component: cost = 1 + 2x_1 + 3x_1^2 + 4x_1^3 - Second component: cost = 4 + 6x_2 - Third component: cost = 5 + 4x_3 + 3x_3^2 list(c(0, 2), c(0, 6), c(0, 4)) represents: - First component: cost = 2x_1 - Second component: cost = 6x_2 - Third component: cost = 4x_3 Default value without user specification: NULL. Please note either unit_costs cost_list_of_vectors must specified. specified, cost_list_of_vectors used. glm_family character string. family glm() outcome model. Default value without user specification: "gaussian" continuous outcomes, "binomial" binary outcomes. link character string. link function glm() outcome model. Default value without user specification: "identity" continuous outcomes, "logit" binary outcomes. optimization_method character string. Specifies method used LAGO optimization. Must either "numerical" "grid_search". Default value without user specification: "numerical". - Use "grid_search" want exhaustively test every possible intervention package compositions LAGO optimization. - Use "numerical" want use gradient-based technique LAGO optimization. Note: optimization_grid_search_step_size provided "numerical", automatically switched "grid_search" (message). confidence_set_alpha numeric value. type error considered confidence set calculations. Default value without user specification: 0.05. weights numeric vector. weights argument glm() outcome model. center_characteristics character vector. names columns dataset represent center characteristics. Note, include_center_effects center_characteristics used together time. example: c("characteristic1") center_characteristics_optimization_values numeric vector. fixed values center characteristics recommended intervention computed. outcome model can depend center characteristics, recommendation specific center characteristic values, .e. optimization answers "optimal intervention center whose characteristics equal values?". Must provided center_characteristics used, must numeric, must length order center_characteristics. example, center_characteristics = c("birth_volume_100"), setting center_characteristics_optimization_values = c(1.75) computes recommended intervention center birth_volume_100 = 1.75. main_components character vector. Specifies main intervention components presence interaction terms. example: c("component1", "component2"). time_effect_optimization_value numeric value. value time effect used LAGO optimization. additional_covariates character vector. names columns dataset represent additional covaraites need included outcome model. includes interaction terms additional covariates. example: c("component2xcomponent4"). center_weights_for_outcome_goal numeric vector. Specifies weights used calculating recommended interventions satisfy outcome goal (weighted) average center. weights need sum 1. Default value without user specification: center, calculate percentage sample size total samples across facilities - percentage serves center's weight. optimization_grid_search_step_size numeric vector. Specifies step size grid search algorithm used LAGO optimization. argument used "grid_search" method; provided optimization_method "numerical", optimization_method automatically switched "grid_search" (message). Default value without user specification: 1/20 range intervention component. confidence_set_grid_step_size numeric vector. Specifies step size grid search algorithm used confidence set calculation. Default value without user specification: 1/20 range intervention component. include_confidence_set boolean. Specifies whether confidence set calculated along recommended interventions. Default value without user specification: TRUE. include_center_effects boolean. Specifies whether fixed effects included outcome model. set TRUE, please make sure input data 'center' column identify centers. Note, include_center_effects center_characteristics used together time. Default value without user specification: FALSE individual level data, TRUE center level data. center_effects_optimization_values numeric vector. center interest used center-specific LAGO optimization. used include_center_effects set TRUE. specified, LAGO optimization carried weighted average centers. include_time_effects boolean. Specifies whether fixed time effects included outcome model. set TRUE, please make sure input data 'period' column identify time periods. Default value without user specification: FALSE. include_interaction_terms boolean. Specifies whether interaction terms intervention components. Please make sure interaciton terms included "intervention_components", follow correct naming scheme: "component1:component3". Default value without user specification: FALSE. prev_recommended_interventions numeric vector. recommended interventions previous stage LAGO optimization. provided, used shrinking method (see Section 5.1 Supplementary material Nevo et al. (2021) details). shrinkage_threshold numeric value. threshold shrinkage method kick . threshold represents proportion distance estimated outcome without intervention, outcome goal. maximum reachable outcome less value, shrinkage method Section 5.1 Supplementary Materials Nevo et al. (2021) applied. maximum reachable outcome greater value, maximum reachable outcome used outcome goal, shrinkage method used. Default value without user specification: 0.25.
